tool: open_composer/research/signal_card.py (rank: top 3000 PIT universe, top-30 long-only books; event: calendar-time books)

trials.note: screening; admission is not a strategy claim

admission_rule.rank: stable_years AND beats_shuffle AND (T1 or T2 top-30 book positive excess at 20 bp in both the full and the 2024+ window at the primary horizon) AND max |t_nonoverlap| over horizons >= 2.5 with the preregistered sign
admission_rule.event_long: beats_redated AND t_dates >= 3 at the primary horizon AND calendar-time book positive excess at 20 bp in the full and the 2024+ window
admission_rule.event_exit: t_dates <= -3 at the primary horizon AND beats_redated: admitted as an exit or avoid signal only

signals.name: rev_5d
signals.rationale: short-term reversal (Lehmann 1990); expect strongest in small, illiquid names, costly turnover

signals.name: overnight_mom_21
signals.rationale: overnight returns persist (Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019, tug of war)

signals.name: season_2_5
signals.rationale: return seasonality, same calendar month years 2-5 (Heston-Sadka 2008)

signals.name: days_to_cover
signals.rationale: days to cover predicts low returns (Hong-Li-Ni-Scheinkman-Yan 2016); rows dated on or after FINRA publication + 1 session; 2018+

signals.name: short_vol_z21
signals.rationale: abnormal daily short volume predicts low returns (Boehmer-Jones-Zhang style on FINRA data; weak public evidence); visible after publication; 2018+

signals.name: news_attention
signals.rationale: media-coverage discount (Fang-Peress 2009); counts only articles visible before the row's open; 2024+ only

signals.name: insider_new_buy
signals.sql: SELECT symbol, trade_date, 1.0 AS value FROM read_parquet('data/features/insider_broad/*.parquet', union_by_name=true) WHERE days_since_last_visible_buy = 0
signals.rationale: a Form 4 open-market buy becomes visible (Lakonishok-Lee 2001; Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski 2012); visible the session after filing; four earlier local variants lost to SPY

signals.name: insider_cluster_buy
signals.sql: SELECT symbol, trade_date, 1.0 AS value FROM read_parquet('data/features/insider_broad/*.parquet', union_by_name=true) WHERE days_since_last_visible_buy = 0 AND buyers_60d >= 2
signals.rationale: new visible buy with two or more distinct buyers in 60 sessions (cluster buying)

signals.name: sec_13d_new
signals.sql: SELECT issuer_symbol AS symbol, visible_session AS trade_date, 1.0 AS value FROM read_parquet('data/features/sec_13d/*.parquet') WHERE is_new_13d
signals.rationale: new 13D (activist) filing (Brav-Jiang-Partnoy-Thomas 2008); entered the open after the session it became visible; local test found the gain is before we can buy

signals.name: rt_bull
signals.rationale: owner's Reversal Trend indicator (QuanTGT reconstruction), bull signal on daily bars

signals.name: rt_reclaim
signals.rationale: owner's Reversal Trend indicator, reclaim signal on daily bars

signals.name: rt_bear
signals.rationale: owner's Reversal Trend indicator, bear signal; expected negative (exit or avoid use)
